summary: Legacy Pro-only wrnchAI body/face/hand tracking CHOP removed in 2022.20000+ builds because new wrnchAI licenses are no longer obtainable.
key_concepts: WrnchAI CHOP was a TouchDesigner Pro operator for body, face, and hand tracking from video streams.
Official docs state wrnchAI licenses are no longer obtainable and this CHOP was removed in 2022.20000+ builds.
Historical use required Windows, an NVIDIA GPU, cuDNN, the full TouchDesigner installer libraries, and a separate wrnchAI license.
The engine ran locally in realtime and could track multiple people with body, face, hand, bounds, and IK-oriented channels.
The Model Folder parameter points at extracted wrnchAI trained models, and initialization occurs when a new model folder is introduced.
This card should guide legacy diagnosis and migration, not new operator planning.

key_params.name: default
key_params.note: Use the same GPU TouchDesigner is running on
